title: Ask HN: Has AI killed the front end engineer role?
excerpt: No, but it's killing a lot of 'glue pieces together' or 'make plugins/tweaks' for a CMS roles.
content_html:
No, but it's killing a lot of 'glue pieces together' or 'make plugins/tweaks' for a CMS roles.

If you're using WordPress, Drupal, etc, then AI is devastating. Any sort of project that's not a massive site build with tons of bespoke features and heavy performance requirements is almost certainly cheaper and easier to build with something like Claude.

And a lot of small projects seem like they'll be lost to AI in general. It seems like the days of small web agencies getting a team of 3-10 developers together to build simple sites for local businesses are quickly coming to a close.

But front end in general isn't doomed. Just engineering roles dealing with smaller, simpler projects.
